observations: Torah 194 contains only 1 bechina edge in the dataset (אדני ↔ דבור), and analysis of the full source text identifies 2 additional missing bechina edges (היכל המלך ↔ דבור and גדר האדם ↔ דבור). Even with all three edges included, all nodes connect to the single hub of דבור — forming one star-shaped component of 4 nodes. There is no independent conceptual domain with 3 or more nodes that is separate from the דבור package. The teaching's entire structure is a single-axis argument: honor's essential nature is speech, speech is the palace of the King (אדני), therefore seeking honor in that palace is disgraceful for a servant. There is no secondary domain (no wisdom cluster, no evil mirror cluster, no letter cluster) that could constitute an independent package. The 'evil' dimension of the teaching (the honor-seeker, the shame) is conveyed through narrative parable, not through bechina equations, and thus generates no package-forming edges.
